semantics.answer: one inclusion-minimal set satisfying guarantee and prevention
semantics.cell_encoding: cell = step * number_of_inputs + input_index; both zero-based
semantics.counterfactuals: all Boolean input assignments through target_step, replayed from the same initial state
semantics.effect: the single output equals 1 at target_step
semantics.guarantee: every input assignment agreeing with selected cells preserves the effect
semantics.minimality: no proper subset still satisfies both; not minimum cardinality
semantics.output_timing: output is emitted by the current-state/current-input transition before changing state
semantics.prevention: some input assignment agreeing with every unselected cell makes the effect false
semantics.selected_value: the observed Boolean value, including zero
